The proposed scope UNRESOLVED status similarly overextends missing version and review metadata despite an express Delhi Section 14(1)(b) proceeding. coverage_limits: All 23 original limitations are mapped to the single focal binding; none is discarded.
The original lease, corporate tenancy recognition and directors' separation are not treated as dates of the alleged disposition.
Censor's occupation is admitted, while the literal subtenancy incidents and tenant-caused divestment remain unestablished.
R.P. Aggarwal's continued presence and M.L. Aggarwal's personal relocation are not automatically attributed to the tenant company's legal possession.
The written-consent allegation remains allegation-level evidence tied to the identified subletting claim.
The ARC rejection and subsequent tribunal dismissal remain prior procedural findings, without invented test-specific reasoning.
No positive assignment-specific link is supplied.
Burden allocation, standard of proof and burden shifts remain NOT_COVERED; their absence is not a universal bar on using the recorded facts.
All materials are retrospective reconstructions; no test labels, claim satisfaction or future court outcome is predicted.
